title: Runtime Stability Dump Falsification Matrix
methodology: separate instrument, target and visibility drift
preserve raw observations and derived classification separately
repeat device experiments across independent runs before promoting stability claims
retain TOKEN_VAZIO when the required source is absent

hypotheses.claim: ASLR base movement alone must not change recognition classification
hypotheses.positive_control: same module name+size surface with changed bases
hypotheses.falsifier: classification other than NO_OBSERVED_DRIFT when only bases change

hypotheses.claim: A compact hash collision must not hide module-surface change
hypotheses.positive_control: same compact hint with changed module size/name surface

hypotheses.claim: Memory ranges are enumerated once and bucketed by exact returned protection
hypotheses.positive_control: single all-range enumeration plus exact protection bucket

hypotheses.claim: Clock progression alone must not classify runtime drift
hypotheses.positive_control: same state with different wall/monotonic clocks
hypotheses.falsifier: RUNTIME_DRIFT caused only by timing fields

hypotheses.claim: Unknown caller reason text is not persisted verbatim
hypotheses.positive_control: arbitrary secret-like reason maps to CALLER_DEFINED
hypotheses.falsifier: raw unknown reason appears in dump

hypotheses.claim: Unsupported or incomplete schema is incomparable, not silently comparable
hypotheses.falsifier: normal drift classification instead of INCOMPARABLE

hypotheses.claim: Collector visibility loss is classified separately from target drift
hypotheses.positive_control: memory-range collector PASS -> TOKEN_VAZIO with target identity unchanged
hypotheses.falsifier: IDENTITY_DRIFT or RUNTIME_DRIFT instead of VISIBILITY_DRIFT

hypotheses.claim: Frida version/runtime change is not target identity drift
hypotheses.positive_control: same target identity with changed Frida version

hypotheses.claim: PID/TID changes are reported but excluded from stability classification
Capture duration and Frida heap footprint are recorded instead of assumed zero
hypotheses.positive_control: dump contains observer timing and heap fields
hypotheses.falsifier: observer fields absent while snapshot claim remains

hypotheses.claim: Each file is exclusive-created, fsynced, SHA-256 sidecar protected and ledger-linked
hypotheses.positive_control: two synthetic writes produce two files and second previous hash equals first digest
hypotheses.falsifier: overwrite, missing sidecar, missing fsync, or broken chain

hypotheses.claim: Remote Frida endpoint requires explicit opt-in
Sequential snapshot is never described as atomic
hypotheses.falsifier: atomic/consistent snapshot claim without suspension protocol

hypotheses.claim: LMKD/SELinux/crash root cause stays TOKEN_VAZIO without independent evidence
Optional thread observers never persist thread names
hypotheses.positive_control: renamed-thread event stores id and names_collected=false only
hypotheses.falsifier: new or previous thread name appears in event payload

hypotheses.claim: Only explicitly allowlisted non-identifying Android properties are collected into the Frida stability dump
hypotheses.positive_control: zygote/ABI/memfd/LMKD/AVB/FBE/VNDK/service-state keys are present while serial/SIM/operator/radio-provisioning keys are absent
hypotheses.falsifier: agent references or emits a forbidden identity/telephony property

required_context: thermal/memory pressure context when performance or kill behavior is claimed
physical_promotion_rule.promotion: A physical stability claim may be promoted only when the relevant hypothesis survives its falsifier across the required independent runs and no required source remains TOKEN_VAZIO.
